title: Uniquely Charred Croatian Meat Skewers
description: A dense and adventurous Croatian dish featuring mitsuba, charred to perfection and wrapped in lotus leaves, this recipe is fodmap friendly and offers a unique flavor experience.
instructions: Preheat a grill to medium high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the minced garlic and chopped mitsuba into a coarse paste.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, salt, and black pepper, then add the pounded garlic and mitsuba paste and mix well.
Add the pork shoulder cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers on the preheated grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred on all sides.
Wrap each skewer in a lotus leaf and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional chopped mitsuba if desired.
Serve with a side of roasted vegetables or a salad for a complete meal.
